evaluator: E8 – Claude Opus 5.5 (Anthropic), re-evaluation of E7's findings on the fixed build, persona: image-analysis specialist in a bioimaging core facility who writes Fiji macros and Python every day, cares about reproducibility, provenance and ImageJ-identical results, and has used napari, QuPath and Icy
method: I re-tested each of E7's 27 problems with the control and sequence E7 used, plus a regression pass, using only the running app at http://127.0.0.1:8766. Evidence comes from screenshots, DOM/ARIA facts, recorder lines, REST responses, Results rows and a TIFF tag dump; I read no source code and no other evaluators' files. Tooling: one persistent headless Google Chrome (Playwright from the provided venv, channel=chrome, swiftshader, 1440×900, host locale), driven through a small local socket so the same browser served the whole session; a short viewport check at 1280×800 and 1920×1080 used the same page. Clean start: memory_pressure 60% free. /api/state showed 0 images, 0 ROIs and 0 results, so there was nothing for Close All to close; the page was loaded fresh. Walked: Open Sample via the palette (Synthetic nuclei, T1 head, Blobs); per-channel display edits; Otsu threshold → Analyze Particles; ROI Manager and Results Clear with confirm/undo; rectangle + M; Z Project; Gaussian σ=500 → ⌘Z; four steps → History jump by keyboard; New Image with out-of-range width; 20-frame 'timeseries' → Tracks wizard; tab close/switch sequence; Script & Recorder (→ Python/→ IJM/API help replace dialogs, typo and unknown-command scripts, IJM getTitle, large editor); Apply Recorded Macro to Folder sheet plus /api/recorder/preview and /api/recorder/ijm; page reload; palette searches (Open Sample, enhance local contrast, clahe, bleach, apply lut, crop/plot profile without selection); Set LUT; Image ▸ Lookup Tables (DOM); File menu (DOM); menubar contrast in both themes; inspector splitter by keyboard; 3-D large view; split view; sheet '?' help and the docs dialog; '?' overlay; Preferences; Save As into my eval_e8 folder plus a TIFF tag dump; Image Info; Gaussian on a calibrated image; File ▸ Close All from the keyboard menu. Because the menubar dropdowns are clipped (E8-1), I reached menu content through keyboard navigation and DOM reads; the palette was used for commands. Not covered: a real screen reader, several users on one server at the same time, '[' pressed again with the brush, and Python out-of-range errors (documented but not run). Clean-up: closed all images via File ▸ Close All (keyboard); cleared the ROI Manager (61) and Results (42) through their confirmed Clear dialogs; removed my one-row Particle Summary table via /api/script/run; cleared both of my recorders (DELETE /api/recorder for both client ids); theme left on Dark; final /api/state: 0 images, 0 ROIs, 0 results, no tables. The browser and driver were closed, and ps shows no Chrome process of mine. saved_max_t1_e8.tif is kept next to this file as evidence.

reassessment.evidence: Repeated E7's sequence: New Image 'timeseries' (20 frames), Open Sample Blobs, closed blobs.tif with its tab ×, clicked the MAX_t1-head.tif tab, then Invert, Smooth, Smooth. Recorder: lumen.run("file.new", …)  # → "timeseries" · lumen.run("file.sample", name='Blobs')  # → "blobs.tif" · lumen.close("blobs.tif") · lumen.select("MAX_t1-head.tif") · lumen.run("edit.invert") · lumen.run("process.smooth") ×2. The IJM export writes close("blobs.tif"); selectWindow("MAX_t1-head.tif");. Screenshots 25_script_recorder.png, 31_to_ijm.png.
reassessment.comment: Small residue: a recorder that starts while an image is already open (after a reload or Clear) writes the first command without lumen.select(...). Fiji's recorder does the same, so I don't count it.

reassessment.evidence: Gaussian σ=500 on MAX_t1-head.tif, then ⌘Z: the toast says 'Undo Gaussian Blur' and the recorder adds lumen.undo("MAX_t1-head.tif"). After four steps (Gaussian σ=1, Invert, Smooth, Median) I jumped back to the first History row with the keyboard (focus + Enter): the recorder adds four lumen.undo("MAX_t1-head.tif") lines, and /api/state history shows four redo entries. Screenshots 21_gauss500_undone.png, 22_history_four.png, 23_history_jump.png.
reassessment.comment: The undo lines are recorded, but the folder batch drops them and keeps the commands they undid (see E7-5).

reassessment.evidence: Inspector edits on synthetic_cells.tif: DAPI max = 1500, Auto on Cytoplasm, eye-toggle on Spots, Viridis in Cytoplasm's LUT dropdown. Recorder: lumen.display("synthetic_cells.tif", channel=1, max=1500) · …channel=2, min=125, max=949.21875 · …channel=3, visible=False · …channel=2, lut='Viridis'. The IJM export turns these into Stack.setChannel(2); setMinAndMax(125, 949.21875); run("Viridis");. Screenshots 07_channels_adjusted.png, 25_script_recorder.png, 31_to_ijm.png.
reassessment.comment: A change to max only isn't converted to IJM ('a display range needs both min and max'), even though the min is known. See E8-3.

reassessment.evidence: /api/recorder is now per browser client (X-Lumen-Client 4b2fcd83150f4a01). It starts with '# Lumen recorder – session started 2026-11-08 05:06:37', holds only my 31 lines and none from other sessions, and the pane auto-scrolls to the newest line. A default recorder that holds someone else's lumen.run("file.close_all") stays separate. Screenshot 25_script_recorder.png.
reassessment.comment: Side effect: the recording is tied to the page load. A reload starts an empty recorder and the old recording can't be reached from the UI (E8-2). Lines still have no timestamps, and IJM runs are still recorded as one script.run_ij_macro blob.

reassessment.evidence: Plugins ▸ Batch ▸ Apply Recorded Macro to Folder… now shows 'Commands to run' as an editable textarea, plus the summary '14 recorded lines from this session's recorder will run on every file (17 open / save / select / display lines left out). Edit the list above before Apply.' Only my own lines appear. But the default list (same as GET /api/recorder/preview) contains lumen.run("filters.gaussian", sigma=500.0) and the Gaussian σ=1 / Invert / Smooth / Median steps that I had undone. That makes you believe undone steps are excluded, when the batch would in fact run my undone σ=500 blur on every file. The list should drop the undone commands together with their undo lines, or at least warn about them.

new_problems.heuristic: Visibility of system status / Consistency and standards (regression)
new_problems.location: Top menubar: every menu (File … Help), at 1280, 1440 and 1920 px wide
new_problems.observation: The dropdowns are invisible. The .menubar is now overflow:auto (clientHeight 27 px, scrollHeight 466–501 px), and the .menu-popover is absolutely positioned inside it, so it is clipped to the 27-px strip. Clicking File highlights the trigger (aria-expanded=true), and the popover (230×474 px at y=35, display:block, opacity 1) is in the DOM, but nothing shows below the bar. elementFromPoint inside the popover's box returns the viewport ('empty-viewport' / 'tool-options'). From the keyboard (F10, ↓) the menubar strip scrolls, so the triggers disappear and one menu item at a time shows in their place. A Fiji user's main way into the 600 commands is unusable with the mouse and barely usable with the keyboard; only ⌘K remains. This is a regression from the E7-12 restyling: in E7 the menus opened normally.
new_problems.evidence: 01_file_menu.png (File open, nothing below), 02_file_menu_clip_zoom.png, 03_kbd_menu_open.png and 66_kbd_close_all_item.png (keyboard: one item replaces the menubar), 64_menu_1920.png; DOM: menubar overflow auto, clientHeight 27 / scrollHeight 501; elementFromPoint misses the popover at 1280/1440/1920.

new_problems.heuristic: Reproducibility / User control and freedom / Error prevention
new_problems.location: Script & Recorder after a page reload
new_problems.observation: The recorder is keyed to an X-Lumen-Client id that is created again on every page load (4b2fcd83150f4a01 → 626bb98d76c84faa) and isn't stored in local or session storage. After a reload, the pane says 'Recorder (0 lines)' with a new session marker, while the editor text (localStorage) survives. My 31-line recording still exists on the server (GET /api/recorder with the old header returns it), but nothing in the UI shows or restores it, and the page gives no warning before unload. One accidental ⌘R (outside the editor) or a browser crash loses the provenance of a whole session.
new_problems.evidence: 33_after_reload_recorder.png; request headers before and after the reload; curl -H 'X-Lumen-Client: 4b2fcd83150f4a01' /api/recorder still returned the lines.

new_problems.heuristic: Reproducibility (macro export fidelity) / Help users recognize errors
new_problems.observation: The ImageJ-macro export emits one run("Undo") for each recorded undo: my History jump became four consecutive run("Undo"); lines. ImageJ's Undo is single-level, so the second one redoes, and the macro ends on a different image from the session. The caveat ('ImageJ's Undo is single-level: a second run("Undo") in a row redoes') appears only in the JSON 'notes', not in the script, although the toast says '…6 notes in the script'. A display change of max only (lumen.display(channel=1, max=1500)) is dropped as '// not converted (a display range needs both min and max)' instead of using the known min. Everything else I checked converted well (selectWindow/close, setAutoThreshold("Otsu dark"), Analyze Particles options, makeRectangle + Measure, Z Project).
new_problems.evidence: 31_to_ijm.png; /api/recorder/ijm response (converted 25, skipped 6, notes ×6 not present in 'script').

new_problems.heuristic: Visibility of system status / Match with TrackMate
new_problems.location: Inspector ▸ Tracks ▸ Wizard ▸ Detect spots (20-frame image)
new_problems.observation: Detection adds one point ROI per frame to the global ROI Manager ('Spots t0' … 'Spots t19', each with its frame in 'position') and switches ROI Manager 'Show all' on. On frame 1/20 the overlay then shows the spots of all 20 frames: the 'Spots t19' label sits at the top-left, and a 400×200 px crop already holds more than 15 spots although 'Spots t0' has 8 points. positives: The recorder is now an honest account of a session: per tab, with a session marker, tab switches as lumen.select("…"), closes as lumen.close("title"), undo/History jumps as lumen.undo("title"), inspector display/LUT edits as lumen.display(…), ROI/Results clears and restores, saves as lumen.save(path), and every image-creating line commented with the resulting title (# → "MAX_t1-head.tif").

'→ IJM' turns the recording into an ImageJ macro that mostly works as is: selectWindow/close, Stack.setChannel + setMinAndMax + run("Viridis"), setAutoThreshold("Otsu dark"), the full Analyze Particles option string, makeRectangle + Measure, Z Project. Every line it can't convert is kept as a '// not converted (reason)' comment instead of vanishing.

Destructive clears are guarded the way I'd want: an alertdialog with the exact count, Cancel focused, a destructive button labelled 'Delete 41 ROIs', an 'Undo clear' toast, palette commands to restore, and recorder lines for both.

Parameter handling is now strict and ImageJ-like: σ=500 is accepted and recorded as 500, an out-of-range New Image width gets an inline message with Apply disabled, and the Python API rejects 'sigmaa' and 'filters.gaussia' with did-you-mean suggestions and no internal paths.
Channel context is explicit: the Threshold panel names the thresholded channel, and threshold.compute, analyze.particles and analyze.measure are recorded with channel=1.
Save As renames the image (tab, Image Info, getTitle()), and Image Info shows 'Derived from: t1-head.tif ▸ Z Project'.
The sheet '?' expands an inline parameter table with defaults, ranges and meaning, and the docs dialog no longer exposes internal design notes.
The batch sheet finally shows the commands it will run, as an editable list with a count of included and left-out lines.

The palette shows selection-dependent commands as disabled, with the requirement and tool keys ('needs an area selection (1, 2, 3, 4)'). Fiji names such as 'Enhance Local Contrast' now find CLAHE, and Image ▸ Lookup Tables lists the LUTs themselves.
Accessibility moved forward: a keyboard-resizable inspector splitter, a real modal 3-D large view, channel-named sliders, eye toggles and inputs, and a statusbar that no longer floods screen readers.
Layout is stable: the tool-options bar is always present, so switching tools no longer moves the image, and the split-view compare pane fits its image.
History rows are keyboard buttons with parameters in their names, and a History jump is reproduced in the recorder.
overall: This is a different product for my use case. The recorder now records what I actually did, per tab, naming the image, the undo and the display state, and it exports to IJM. Parameters are validated like ImageJ, the Python API refuses typos, destructive clears are guarded and recorded, and Save As behaves like Fiji. Fifteen of E7's 27 problems are fixed, ten are narrower and two remain. I still couldn't hand it to facility users today, for three reasons. First, the restyled menubar no longer shows any dropdown (E8-1, severity 4), so the Fiji-familiar entry point is gone for mouse users; that alone blocks a release. Second, the reproducibility chain has two holes: a page reload silently starts an empty recorder and orphans the session's recording (E8-2), and the folder batch's default command list keeps steps that were undone, while its help text claims undo lines are handled (E7-5), which is exactly how a σ=500 blur I undid would end up on every file. Third, the server is still one shared environment (preferences, ROI Manager, Results, recent files, server file system, code execution: E7-21), which matters on a facility machine.
